scope.allsoulsDayOffice: Beyond the three principal Dead-Office Hours: proper short Hours and Compline from All Souls' proper must be handled; not a three-hour-only replacement for the whole 2 November office.
scope.allSoulsMatins: three nocturns; nine lessons; fixed All Souls lesson overrides from Sancti/11-02
scope.vespers1960Rule: Vespers of Dead assigned to 2 November; customary devotional Vespers after All Saints II Vespers on 1 November distinct and optional.
scope.deadOfficePsalmDoxology: Requiem aeternam instead of Gloria Patri

gates: Resolve DO source references, common orations, Invitatory and canonical endings; do not strip @ / $ / & macros as prayer text.
Acquire and check remaining Matins and Lauds Psalter verses, canticles, and full hourly 1960 substitutions, including lessons 4–9 on All Souls.
Independent photographed 1961–62 Roman Breviary collation required for exact-edition certification; pinned DO source alone is not sufficient.
Verify English and French variants against their own witnesses; do not claim French Crampon wording for DO's existing French Office translations.
Differentiate votive Office from 2 November proper and 1 November optional devotional customary Vespers; do not infer a universal service time.
Build source-complete offline reader with distinct hours and no duplicates, then mobile 390px and EN/FR/LA reader test.
Keep source-only material excluded from the curated GitHub Pages bundle until public release gate passes.
